planned_description: Redesign all SIX masked characters as flat FRONT-ELEVATION pixel-art sprites. They must stare STRAIGHT OUT OF THE SCREEN toward the viewer, as symmetrical paper-doll game sprites. THIS IS A POSE REPLACEMENT, do not retain the old three-quarter pose. Highest priority: the UPPER LEFT GREEN ARCHER must have a centered FULL FRONT FACE with BOTH EYES and BOTH EARS visible equally, a horizontal shoulder line and a front-facing chest. Put the bow upright at one OUTER SIDE, away from the face; show both front-facing boots. The LOWER LEFT GRAY SHIELD WARRIOR needs a new perfectly frontal pose: symmetrical square helmet and T-shaped visor centered above the breastplate, both shoulder plates equally visible, shield on one outer side and upright sword on the other, both boot toes facing the viewer. The PURPLE WIZARD between them and the chasm faces the viewer with two glowing eyes inside the FRONT opening of the hood and a visible robe clasp. Do not show any character's back. All three monsters on the right also face the viewer symmetrically. Keep compact sizes and the same floor-cell support points, both soles inside ONE tile, no bases, discs, rings or pedestals. Match coarse dark pixel-art clusters and muted dungeon colors. Keep the isometric room, tile floor, chasm and bridge composition. The ROOM is isometric; the characters are FLAT FRONTAL SPRITES, never isometric, never profile.

brief.title: Две стороны разлома · персонажи фронтально
brief.prompt:
Create one coarse pixel-art dungeon battle scene. First attached dungeon image is STYLE ONLY: copy muted gray-green stone, dusty brown/mauve walls, purple-black void, restrained cyan/ochre accents, compact large-headed sprites, coarse clusters and sparse detail. DO NOT copy its top-down camera. The tile geometry reference defines our ISOMETRIC floor: symmetric diamond tile tops with width:height EXACTLY 4:3, not thin 2:1 diamonds. Floor directions slope down-right and down-left; every seam follows those two axes. Low walls follow the isometric grid. Show the whole small room with margin, no text or panels. STRICT PLACEMENT: six small combatants, three adventurers and three monsters, each alone on one clearly visible floor tile. Midpoint between both soles at the center of that tile; both feet inside that diamond, never on a seam. Characters short enough to leave floor visible around feet. Boots touch the floor directly: NO pedestals, bases, discs, plinths, circular platforms, rings or selection circles. Only a tiny contact shadow, no broad oval shadow resembling a base. Separate readable shield, bow, dagger, caster and monster silhouettes. Crisp stepped pixels, simple shading, no smoothing or noisy texture. 4:3 image format.
CHARACTERS: flat front-facing 2D sprites like the style reference, with horizontal shoulders and face/chest looking toward the viewer; do NOT rotate their bodies to isometric. The ROOM AND FLOOR remain fully isometric. Both feet still touch the center of one diamond tile.
ROOM: Two unequal tiled stone floor areas separated by a narrow fissure; one short wide stone bridge near the front, rear route blocked by a fallen slab. Three figures on each side, each on one dry tile.
brief.iteration_reason: Second targeted P05-F repair: archer remained three-quarter; explicitly replace left two silhouettes with flat frontal poses.
